source_boundary.handoff: committed G2 invocation context and durable Core ingress premise into the WP-010 Asset and WP-013A/013B Channel seams
source_boundary.authority: Core remains the only authority for Block, Ingress, Action, and future Asset identity; Asset and Channel services derive every trusted producer premise from a committed Core transaction and never mint authority of their own
source_boundary.effect_boundary: before Asset import, host.ingress.submit, and outbound Channel effects

classification.product_red: asserts a WP-010/013A/013B product contract that is not yet implemented; the probe exercises the current durable Core transaction first, so every harness step succeeds and only the missing named seam turns the case red
classification.pass: negative authority or premise-direction control already enforced by the accepted G1-G3 boundaries; regression here is a product violation, so the case must stay green
classification.blocked: later WP-013B seam whose interfaces (WP-010 Asset authority and WP-013A Channel send contract) are not frozen; retained in the matrix, never executed until both freeze

cases.name: bounded_import_and_crash_recovery_require_a_core_owned_import_seam
cases.seam: host.asset.import and host.asset.status (schemas/asset-import.schema.json); ImportId persists ACCEPTED before acquisition; crash restarts from ACCEPTED unless a verified staging object exists
cases.causal_red: the only durable draft route today is CoreCommand::Ingress, which commits the block verbatim with a caller-chosen block_id; there is no ImportId, byte bound, staging object, AVAILABLE gate, or crash-restart record, so the round trip cannot begin
cases.verify: submit an asset_input ingress draft, then require an import record bound to an ImportId with an enforced size limit; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: canonical_asset_identity_and_dedup_are_core_authority_only
cases.seam: AssetId = ast_b3_ + lowercase unpadded base32 of blake3-256 over accepted bytes; identical accepted bytes within one security domain resolve to one AssetId; non-canonical encodings rejected
cases.causal_red: no AssetId minting authority exists anywhere in the Core transaction catalog, so identical accepted bytes cannot resolve to a single content-addressed identity and dedup is unverifiable
cases.verify: import identical bytes twice through the seam and require one AssetId and one durable lifecycle record; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: mime_sniffing_and_security_refusal_precede_availability
cases.seam: declared media type is only a hint; bounded sniffing, MEDIA_TYPE_MISMATCH, UNSAFE_MEDIA, SOURCE_DENIED, SSRF policy, strict base64, and bounded streams
cases.causal_red: untrusted bytes ride verbatim inside a committed Block with no sniffing, no media allowlist, no SSRF policy, and no bounded acquisition, so refusal outcomes cannot be produced
cases.verify: ingress an HTML payload labeled image/png and require MEDIA_TYPE_MISMATCH or UNSAFE_MEDIA before any availability; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: leases_pins_and_gc_use_atomic_durable_retention
cases.seam: unguessable LeaseId with finite expiry; lease creation atomic with non-tombstone check; mark/tombstone/sweep with reference recheck; tombstone never resurrects
cases.causal_red: there is no lease, pin, or GC record in the durable snapshot, so retention races and tombstone semantics cannot be exercised
cases.verify: acquire a finite model-output lease, then require the lease to be atomic with a non-tombstone check and a GC sweep that aborts on a new reference; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: required_replicas_never_expose_unverified_bytes
cases.seam: replica state machine disabled|pending_upload|present|upload_failed|pending_delete|delete_failed|deleted; remote_required stays REPLICATING/REPLICA_FAILED and returns REMOTE_REPLICA_FAILED
cases.causal_red: no replica state exists and no remote_required path can be demanded, so an unverified required replica could never be refused today
cases.verify: request remote_required and require non-available REPLICATING with REMOTE_REPLICA_FAILED on unverified upload; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: security_domain_isolation_is_recorded_and_enforced
cases.seam: durable security_domain per asset record; read/stream/view authorize the caller domain; a hash match across domains grants no cross-domain read
cases.causal_red: the durable snapshot has no asset record and therefore no security_domain field, so identical bytes in two domains are indistinguishable and cross-domain reads are unenforceable
cases.verify: import identical bytes in two security domains and require distinct domain-bound records with a denied cross-domain read; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: authenticated_text_round_trip_runs_producer_to_durable_premise_to_consumer
cases.seam: host.ingress.submit derives producer identity and assigns Ingress/Block identity; Channel module consumes committed Blocks and emits only org.dolly.channel.send ActionResult parts
cases.causal_red: CoreCommand::Ingress accepts a caller-shaped block and block_id verbatim, so no producer identity is derived; there is no Channel package, no send ActionContract execution, and no round trip
cases.verify: derive a producer-bound text ingress, deliver it to a Channel module, and require a channel-owned outbound send action from activation output; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: ingress_reconciliation_reads_status_instead_of_resubmitting
cases.seam: host.ingress.status returns absent|committed for the same authenticated principal and key; only authoritative absent permits a byte-identical replay
cases.causal_red: the only reconciliation today is resubmitting the identical CoreCommand::Ingress, which returns the prior mapping; there is no status read, so a lost-response caller cannot distinguish absent from committed without resubmission
cases.verify: after a committed ingress with a lost response, require a status read that returns the committed mapping without resubmitting; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: sender_conversation_session_and_capability_are_authorized_before_any_dispatch
cases.seam: authenticated transport, authorized sender/conversation/session, capability check before send, session bound to account and policy, no discovery of other sessions
cases.causal_red: no Channel transport or session map exists, so there is no authorization decision for any inbound event or outbound action to fail before dispatch
cases.verify: present an unauthenticated event and a session-missing send and require refusal before any dispatch record; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: outbound_replay_returns_the_existing_result_without_resend
cases.seam: action_id is the outbound idempotency key; confirmed action replay returns the existing result; unknown sends are never auto-repeated
cases.causal_red: no outbound ledger or action_id identity exists, so confirmed replay cannot return a prior result and unknown-send quarantine cannot be proven
cases.verify: dispatch once, confirm, replay the same action_id and require the existing result with a single dispatch record; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: unknown_and_partial_outcomes_are_explicit_and_non_retryable
cases.seam: timeout or crash after possible send yields outcome unknown; partial multi-piece send is terminal partial with result null, code CHANNEL_PARTIAL_DELIVERY, retryable false, outcome applied, per-piece ordinal details
cases.causal_red: no dispatch record or outcome envelope exists, so a lost send response has no unknown disposition and a partial send has no failed/applied ActionResult mapping
cases.verify: lose a send response and require outcome unknown; split a send and require terminal partial with the exact ActionResult mapping; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: outbound_rate_limits_use_bounded_queues_and_caller_deadlines
cases.seam: bounded outbound queues, configured rate/concurrency limits, caller deadlines, transport unavailability never blocks Core input state
cases.causal_red: there is no outbound transport queue or rate configuration, so no backpressure or deadline decision can be observed
cases.verify: surpass a rate limit and require bounded queuing with caller deadline failure rather than unbounded growth; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: credentials_paths_and_signed_urls_never_enter_metadata_or_logs
cases.seam: inbound metadata omits transport credentials, cookies, local paths, signed attachment URLs; channel metadata is namespaced and content-free
cases.causal_red: the durable block today copies whatever JSON the caller submits, so a draft carrying credentials or a local path would be persisted verbatim with no redaction boundary
cases.verify: ingress a draft carrying a credential-shaped field and require it to be absent from the committed record; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: channel_cannot_append_to_a_page_or_advance_a_cursor_directly
cases.seam: the Channel's only durable write route is host.ingress.submit; it must never append to a Page, mint a Block or Asset ID, or advance a Module cursor
cases.causal_red: a Channel implementation does not exist, so the negative route set cannot be exercised against it; the Core-side premise that there is no third-party direct-mutation command is covered by G4-CONTROL-NO-DIRECT-MUTATION-001
cases.verify: once the Channel seam exists, prove every Channel write lands in a committed Block through ingress and none mutates a Page or Module cursor directly; absent implementation -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: asset_import_and_send_seam_binds_channel_parts_to_core_assets
cases.blocked_reason: WP-010 Asset authority (G4-WP010-* product_red) and WP-013A Channel send contract (G4-WP013A-* product_red) are not frozen; this seam must not be executed against unstable interfaces
cases.seam: org.dolly.channel.send carries Core Part AssetRefs; the Channel imports or pins through host.asset.import and never trusts action media_type
cases.causal_red: no AssetRef Part exists, so a Channel send cannot bind parts to committed hash-checked Assets

cases.name: mime_and_lease_round_trip_through_core_assets
cases.blocked_reason: depends on the WP-010 MIME/lease contract and the WP-013A send ActionContract; interfaces are not frozen; blocked with G4-WP013B-ASSET-SEND-SEAM-001
cases.seam: outbound Asset parts read under a short Asset lease with authoritative detected media type
cases.causal_red: no lease or detected-media-type authority exists today

cases.name: media_abuse_round_trip_refuses_unsafe_or_unowned_media
cases.blocked_reason: needs the WP-010 security/domain contract and WP-013A authorization; interfaces are not frozen; blocked with G4-WP013B-ASSET-SEND-SEAM-001
cases.seam: unsafe media, cross-domain AssetRefs, and forged media_type are refused before any send dispatch
cases.causal_red: no media or domain authority exists, so abuse cannot be refused

cases.name: producer_premise_is_durable_explicit_and_never_reversible
cases.assertion: identical ingress replay returns the prior mapping; a different digest under the same key is STORAGE_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, never an overwrite; the record survives a store reopen

cases.name: ingress_keys_are_producer_scoped_without_echo_collision
references: crates/dolly-core-reducer/tests/wp004_conformance.rs::ingress identity is scoped to the producer
cases.assertion: two producer sources using the same ingress key yield independent durable records; replaying the first source returns only its prior mapping

cases.name: action_names_are_owner_fenced_against_cross_extension_forgery
cases.assertion: org.dolly.channel.send parses only for owner org.dolly.channel; any other owner or foreign-prefixed action name is rejected

cases.name: core_transaction_catalog_has_no_third_party_page_or_cursor_mutation
references: crates/dolly-core-reducer/src/command.rs::CoreCommand catalog contains no page-append or cursor-advance variant
cases.assertion: the exhaustive CoreCommand catalog publishes external drafts only through Ingress and RuntimeEvent; no variant appends a Page or advances a Module cursor; every durable write passes the Core transaction

cases.name: block_bytes_stay_untrusted_until_a_core_asset_authority_exists
references: crates/dolly-core-reducer/src/types.rs::CoreSnapshot carries no asset, lease, pin, or replica record
crates/dolly-core-reducer/src/command.rs::CoreCommand contains no asset-import or AssetRef-minting variant
cases.assertion: an ingress draft carrying asset_input bytes is committed verbatim as untrusted Block content with no AssetId, content hash record, or availability claim; the Core transaction catalog mints no asset identity today
